title: Inherited event and completion summaries in the history window have a detail route: compacted non-note history rows carry a locator that returns the complete inherited record member, the same way notes do
outcome: Inherited event and completion summaries in the history window have a detail route: compacted non-note history rows carry a locator that returns the complete inherited record member, the same way notes do
acceptance: a compacted inherited event or completion summary in show --history prints its RECORD_HASH:INDEX locator and show REF --note LOCATOR (or an equivalent --event detail) returns the complete member framed as data with its byte size; the window shape and totals are unchanged

completion.summary: Inherited event and completion rows in show --history keep their original size, flag a shortened summary and offer a detail command. show REF --note RECORD:event-N or RECORD:completion returns the whole summary and the complete member framed as data, with member_bytes. Every stored field is included, the actor is shown as its display label, and next returns to --history. Malformed and foreign locators are refused. Help and docs are updated.
